top_signals.headline: ‘Novel’ Partnership Sours Into ‘Hostile Takeover’
top_signals.summary: ‘Novel’ Partnership Sours Into ‘Hostile Takeover’ kathryn.palmer… Thu, 09/03/2026 - 03:00 AM Three years after Antioch and Otterbein Universities partnered to widen student access to academic programs, Otterbein’s president led an effort to dissolve Antioch’s board and fire its new president. Antioch has taken legal action to preserve its autonomy. Byline(s) Kathryn Palmer
